vulnerabilities.name: Arbitrary Code Execution (ACE)
vulnerabilities.description: Tool lets the agent execute Python code, which can be exploited to run unauthorized commands. If an attacker influences the prompt (directly or via the LLM), they could inject harmful Python code (e.g. calling OS commands via os.system or using exec). This effectively gives remote code execution on the host. Without sandboxing, the agent could read/write files or escalate privileges on the system.

security_framework_mapping.OWASP LLM Top 10:
LLM05 - Improper Output Handling
LLM06 - Excessive Agency
security_framework_mapping.OWASP Agentic: T11 - Unexpected RCE and Code Attacks

vulnerabilities.remediation:
• Restrict AI code generation permissions
• Implement sandbox environment where code execution is limited
• Implement execution control policies that flag AI generated code with elevated privileges for manual review
